idea: Body parts & opposites – BIG and small (THE MALL toy store): a GIANT soft teddy bear pops up right beside Baby Ava and she gasps ('Wow! Look! A BIG teddy!'); chorus 'Big and small! Big and small!'; she stretches her arms out WIDE to show how BIG the teddy is ('Big, big, big! Arms out wide! My teddy is so big!'); then a tiny little teddy sits on her open palm ('Small, small, small! A tiny teddy! Hands close together! Small, small!'); copy-me: arms out wide for big, hands close together for small; she holds both and asks the viewer 'Which one is small? Hmm?' (pause) – 'This one! Small! Yay!'; lesson: opposites big and small. Loop: the hook framing again, the giant teddy and the tiny teddy together, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Opposites BIG and small: the giant teddy is big (arms out wide), the tiny teddy is small (hands close together).
calendar: Friday slot 1 – Body parts & opposites (body parts were the 6 Nov long song; today opposites #1: big/small).
characters: BABY AVA: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby girl with short fluffy curly brown hair, one small curly ponytail on top with a sparkly pink star hair clip, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks. wearing a soft yellow dress with ruffle sleeves and a small pink flower, and pink baby shoes with bows.
supporting: THE BIG TEDDY: a GIANT fluffy light-brown teddy bear with round ears, a cream muzzle, big shiny black button eyes, a friendly smile and a big RED ribbon bow. THE TINY TEDDY: the same teddy, thumb-sized.
setting: THE MALL: a bright, clean shopping mall with a toy store with big windows, an ice cream shop with pastel colors, a small carousel and big green plants.

learning.goal: Tell BIG from small: the giant teddy is big, the tiny teddy is small.
learning.shown_how: Shot 1-2 the giant teddy (head twice Ava's head) and Ava's arms out wide; shot 3 a thumb-sized teddy on her palm; shot 4 both together and she points at the small one.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:21 'Which one is small? Hmm?' + 0:23-0:24 humming pause (question boing) -> 0:25 'This one! Small! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: arms out wide for BIG (0:06), hands close together for small (0:15)
learning.fact_check: Same teddy design in two sizes so only size differs. No text/letters/numbers in frames. Note: C1 added small plush toys in shelf bins behind her in shot 3 (background only).
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, soft daylight, big friendly teddy, nothing scary.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: a giant teddy pops up
interactive pause: Which one is small?

story_order.tiny teddy: absent shots 1-2, on her palm from shot 3
